eligibility_rules.E1_ELIGIBLE_AFTER_SEPARATE_AUTHORIZATION: All AUTH-E1 gates plus full per-scope evidence; not assigned in 56.3A
eligibility_rules.E1_PENDING_SCIENTIFIC_INPUT_PROVENANCE: State equivalent; complete legitimate inputs unproved
eligibility_rules.TEXT_E1_INELIGIBLE: Any exact text alignment or future row representation proof absent

terminology.E1: Feature-level explanation of one specific unimodal predictive model
terminology.E2: Analytical multimodal fusion explanation at modality level
terminology.E3: Calibration mapping explanation or calibration-state inspection
terminology.historical_E1: Historical frozen predictor explanation with incompletely recovered scientific input chain
terminology.prospective_complementary_E1: New predeclared explanation analysis of eligible reconstructed states and controlled TRAIN/T1 populations

unknown: Fail closed; retain in coverage denominator; never silently drop
